name: video-player
title: Video Player
author: Eduardo Retana
description: Video player with custom controls for play, seek, volume, speed, and fullscreen, plus keyboard shortcuts.

meta.descriptionEs: Reproductor con controles propios de reproducción, barra, volumen, velocidad y pantalla completa, y atajos de teclado.

examples.title: Reproductor de video
examples.description: Reproductor con controles propios de reproducción, barra, volumen, velocidad y pantalla completa, y atajos de teclado.

api.description: Accessible name of the region. Default Video.

api.name: shortcuts
api.description: Space or K play, arrows seek and change volume, M mutes, F toggles fullscreen.

api.description: Play, pause, seek, volume, speed, and fullscreen labels default to English.

docs: Import VideoPlayer from the installed UI file. Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite a primitive the host already has. The item ships no theme, cssVars, or fixed colors.
